metadata.description: YapCut by alexmuresan.com: a short-form content engine plus a weekly lead-magnet engine. Outlier Radar researches your niche and writes weekly ready-to-film scripts to a tracked dashboard. The Lead Magnet Report turns one category's measured data into a branded paginated report that posts natively as a LinkedIn document. The TikTok Yap Editor turns raw phone clips into finished vertical videos. All three are creator-agnostic via a one-time discovery interview.

plugins.name: outlier-radar
plugins.description: Weekly viral-outlier research + ideation engine with optional SHOW MODE, plus the LEAD MAGNET REPORT. NEW in 3.4: the VOICE STACK writes every script against verbatim transcripts of YOU speaking, with cadence targets measured from your own corpus instead of hand-picked constants, and a rejection ledger that makes a line you kill stay dead. First run asks for 20-30 minutes of you talking unscripted, and everything downstream is grounded in that. Weekly scripts + LinkedIn twins land on a self-contained tracked dashboard. Data lives in a local workspace plugin updates never touch.

plugins.name: tiktok-yap-editor
plugins.description: Turn raw phone clips into finished vertical TikTok/Reels/Shorts. Mode A talking-head: transcript-first cut, zero dead air, brand captions, an auto-fitted on-screen hook that never clips, automatic stutter/restart catching. Mode B day-in-the-life: script the voiceover, lock picture to b-roll, record to a guide. Brand-agnostic via first-run discovery.
